name: Greyhound Australia student discount
summary: 10% off standard adult Greyhound coach fares for high school and tertiary students with a valid student card.
key: High school and tertiary students can receive 10% off the standard adult fare when travelling with Greyhound.
who: You need a valid Australian student card or International Student Identity Card (ISIC).
how: Enter your student card number during the booking process.
catches: Greyhound's page also says Australian UNiDAYS members can get discounts on Travel Passes and Flexible fares.

source.label: Greyhound Australia: Are student discounts available?

evidence.quote: Yes. High school and tertiary students can receive 10% off the standard adult fare when travelling with Greyhound.
To be eligible, you'll need a valid Australian student card or International Student Identity Card (ISIC).
